concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-business-accounts-view-transfers-details]] — 2019-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Customer Area/Transfers API guide to list and inspect Business Accounts transfer states and download instruction-confirmation letters; list examples conflict with stated query constraints, and a letter is not bank-receipt proof.
warnings: The captured list example conflicts with the stated under-six-month date range and identifier requirement; booked status and instruction confirmation must not be read as beneficiary receipt.
